posts.text: Today, my Military Academy Selection Board met to interview candidates for our nation’s service academies. I thank the candidates and the Selection Board for their commitment to this process and willingness to serve. https://t.co/MH7MYnEz4d

As severe rainfall continues to move across Iowa this afternoon and evening, I urge everyone to follow guidance from local officials, avoid unnecessary travel, and keep aware of the forecast. https://t.co/rVodi1xf5N

I am deeply saddened by the passing of Ray Gaesser.

He was an incredible leader for our state, and Iowa benefited greatly from his experience, wisdom, and passion for bettering the lives of our farmers.

I am especially grateful to have worked with Ray through his service on my Agriculture Advisory Board. Lynette and I are praying for Ray’s family and all those who had the privilege of knowing him.

Earlier this year the Administration delivered a historic win for farmers, energy producers, and drivers by releasing record level obligations for homegrown biofuels. 

At a time when our farm economy needs our help the most, I am concerned that changes to SRE exemptions would undermine domestic demand.

This morning, my staff attended the Kossuth Area Economic Development Corporation Annual Breakfast in Whittemore. 

Partnering with communities like Whittemore is vital to strengthen our Main Streets, grow our economy, and drive future investments. https://t.co/kNrYxAtDaQ

It was great to have Secretary of Education Linda McMahon in Fort Dodge to announce the historic first approval of the Workforce Pell Program — the Iowa Central Emergency Medical Technician Program. 

This is great news for the next generation of Iowans looking to enter the workforce!

I am pleased to see the Stop Insider Trading Act, which I co-sponsored, pass the House.

Public service should always be about serving the people, not personal financial gain. Members of Congress should not be getting richer because of the office they hold.

Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts, small businesses are seeing real relief—and you can hear it for yourself:

“Following its [corporate tax rate] reduction to 21%, Sukup hired roughly 200 additional employees, growing our workforce by a third.” — Tom Mangan, President and CEO of Sukup Manufacturing

Small businesses like Sukup Manufacturing are growing, hiring, and investing thanks to the Working Families Tax Cuts!

This week, Team Feenstra had the joy of joining the kickoff games for the Iowa Girls State Softball Tournament in Fort Dodge, where nearly 40 teams competed across five classes!

Iowa continues to lead the way in athletics, and I can’t wait to see how far these talented athletes go. Good luck to all the teams!

I’m praying for everyone injured and for the family of the individual who tragically lost their life in yesterday’s devastating train crash in Arion.

I’m grateful to the first responders who responded quickly and courageously to the scene. Please join me in keeping everyone affected in your prayers.
We mourn the loss of these brave Americans and honor their service and sacrifice. I pray for the families and loved ones of our fallen servicemembers. https://t.co/y18OhUDfk7

This summer, I welcomed my final cohort of interns as a Member of Congress.

It has been a joy to have so many talented Iowans, students, and young professionals engage in public service, experience the federal policymaking process, and help serve Iowa’s Fourth District.

Aubrey and Elle have played an essential role in our office. They have answered calls from constituents each day and ensured their voices and concerns are heard. I am incredibly grateful for their hard work, dedication, and service, and our entire team has been fortunate to have them with us.

Today, I had the honor of accepting the NCGA President’s Award in recognition of my advocacy for our corn growers and year-round E15.

Representing the largest corn-producing district in the nation, I have seen firsthand the challenges facing our farmers. That’s why I was proud to help champion and pass year-round E15 in the House.

Our work is far from done. I look forward to working with my colleagues in the Senate to get this bill across the finish line and signed into law.

The RuralSTAMINA Biomanufacturing Research initiative, led by Iowa State, has been named as a NSF Regional Innovation Engine. This initiative will receive $15 million over the next 2 years to launch the NSF Biomanufacturing Engine which will aim to accelerate the bioeconomy by creating new economic opportunities for producers and communities across Iowa and Nebraska.

This investment in creating new value-added products has the potential to grow to as much as $160 million over the next decade.

A huge congratulations to Plas-Tech Tooling in Garner for advancing to the semifinals of the Freedom 250 Patriot Pitch Competition!

Selected from thousands of applicants, this competition recognizes the very best of America’s small businesses that drive innovation, create jobs, and fuel economic growth.

I had the privilege to visit Plas-Tech Tooling, and have seen their incredible machining capabilities. Iowans like Dean and Marcia Sonquist are one of the many reasons our Main Streets thrive. Please join me in congratulating them on this outstanding achievement!
I was honored to work with @FLOTUS to help get this bill across the finish line for our nation's foster children. https://t.co/S4CI87Ki1U

Trump Accounts are now live!

If your child was born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028, and has a valid Social Security number, they are eligible to receive $1,000 to invest in their future and jump-start the American Dream. https://t.co/ESNGLOzArC

Today, we celebrate 250 years of American independence!

As we commemorate this historic milestone, we honor the generations of brave men and women who fought to secure and defend the freedoms we cherish. May we never take those blessings for granted.

Happy Independence Day! https://t.co/xLIkvwGPtb

This week marks one year since Republicans prevented the largest tax increase in American history by passing the Working Families Tax Cuts.

From doubling the death tax exemption and making the small business tax deduction permanent to eliminating taxes on tips and overtime, Republicans delivered meaningful tax relief to more than 97% of Americans.

As a member of the Ways and Means Committee, I was honored to help lead this effort and will continue fighting to keep taxes low for hardworking families, farmers, workers, and small businesses.

I am honored to announce that communities in Northwest Iowa will receive more than $27 million in FEMA Disaster Relief funding for recovery following the devastating floods and other natural disasters, including $22 million for the City of Rock Valley. 

I have worked closely with local officials and FEMA in Washington, D.C., to help ensure our communities receive the support and resources they need to recover.

Our work is not done. I will continue working with local, state, and federal officials to secure every federal dollar needed to help Northwest Iowa fully recover and rebuild.

With student-athletes now earning more than ever before, many are struggling with complicated tax obligations and aren't seeking financial counseling until it's too late. 

In Congress, it’s important that we help the next generation build financial literacy and better navigate the tax code so they can keep what they earn well beyond their school years.

Great news for Iowa’s seniors!

AmeriCorps has awarded more than $2.8 million in Iowa through the FY26 AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP Grant Competition.

This funding will help expand transportation services, intergenerational education, elder abuse and financial exploitation prevention, opioid prevention efforts, housing assistance, and other critical services that improve the lives of older Iowans.

I applaud President Trump and Sec. Rollins for releasing the Regenerative Feedstock rule and to ensure that farmers can see more benefit from biofuels policy like 45Z or year-round E15. 

These actions create new opportunities for our farmers, strengthen American energy independence, and ensure rural communities across Iowa continue to lead the way in feeding and fueling the world.

Today, Team Feenstra is volunteering at Iowa’s booth at the Great American State Fair.

In celebration of America’s 250th anniversary, the Great American State Fair showcases the very best of each state, giving visitors to the capital the opportunity to experience each state.

I hope those visiting take time to visit Iowa's booth!

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.
